reviewers.summary: The nonce helper and dependency pin tests cover their stated cases. The root theme, root nonce wiring, and NFR-006 styling requirements can regress while the corresponding named tests still pass.

findingList.message: The test does not cover the production AltivaneRoot behavior required by the theme selection criterion.

evidence.codePathTraced: FluentProvider_theme_selection_contract renders FluentProvider directly and sets the document theme and localStorage itself; it never renders AltivaneRoot.
evidence.failureScenario: If AltivaneRoot stops resolving the stored choice, setting data-theme, or persisting the resolved choice, this test still passes.

findingList.message: The renderer test does not exercise the production root wiring required by the nonce style criterion.

evidence.codePathTraced: signed_in_shell_marks_every_griffel_style creates its own renderer with a hard-coded nonce and renders its own providers; it never renders AltivaneRoot.
evidence.failureScenario: If AltivaneRoot omits the RendererProvider or fails to apply the document nonce, this test still passes using its independently configured renderer.

findingList.message: The named test does not verify the NFR-006 color-literal and Fluent-token criterion.

evidence.codePathTraced: Colour_literals_and_fluent_tokens_contract only inspects manifest dependency names and does not inspect frontend/src files or style values.
evidence.failureScenario: Adding a hex, rgb(), or hsl() color literal outside altivaneTheme.ts, or using raw spacing, radii, elevation, font, or motion values, leaves the manifest unchanged and the test passes.

reviewers.summary: The dependency pin test checks the requested package versions and dependency list. The app-root theme, nonce renderer, and source color/token contracts can regress while their named tests still pass.

findingList.message: The named test does not cover the production AltivaneRoot behavior required by the theme selection criterion.

evidence.codePathTraced: FluentProvider_theme_selection_contract renders FluentProvider directly and sets localStorage and document.documentElement.dataset.theme itself; it does not render the exported AltivaneRoot.
evidence.failureScenario: If AltivaneRoot ignores the stored choice, resolves the wrong theme, or fails to persist the resolved choice, this test still passes because it supplies the provider and state itself.

findingList.message: The named style test bypasses AltivaneRoot, so it does not verify that the production root applies the document nonce to every emitted style.

evidence.codePathTraced: signed_in_shell_marks_every_griffel_style creates a renderer with a hard-coded nonce and renders its own RendererProvider and FluentProvider; it does not render AltivaneRoot.
evidence.failureScenario: If AltivaneRoot fails to read the document nonce or omits the renderer provider, this test still passes using its independently configured renderer.

findingList.message: The named audit does not test the NFR-006 color-literal and Fluent-token criterion, including the required hangar color migration.

evidence.codePathTraced: Colour_literals_and_fluent_tokens_contract inspects only manifest dependency names and does not inspect frontend/src files or style values.
evidence.failureScenario: Adding a hex, rgb(), or hsl() color literal under frontend/src outside altivaneTheme.ts, or using raw spacing or motion values, leaves the manifest unchanged and the test passes.

reviewers.summary: No concrete security vulnerability is reachable in the changed code. Theme choices are restricted to fixed values, and the nonce is read from the document and passed to the Griffel renderer.
